scope: MS0/MS3 dependency repair — engine dependency tree for 37 MS0 pages cross-referenced against 875 unwired engines
evidence_sources: mcp-server/src/tools/dispatchers/ (97 dispatchers — verified businessDispatcher, securityDispatcher, qualityDispatcher, calcDispatcher, edmDispatcher, turningDispatcher, millDispatcher all present)
Grep 143 action-name matches across 23 dispatchers for revenue surface keywords

methodology.step_1: Enumerated 37 MS0 pages from spec lines 73-79: SFC(6) MILL(5) LATHE(7) WEDM(5) QUALITY(4) ADMIN(7) LEARN(3) = 37.
methodology.step_2: Mapped each page-group to required engine families via spec keywords + JM Die profile + dispatcher digest.
methodology.step_3: Cross-referenced required families against 875 unwiredEngines[] names: SFC=8, MILL=4, LATHE=106, WEDM=67, QUALITY=7, ADMIN=11, LEARN=29 unwired matches.
methodology.step_4: Cross-referenced against existing wired actions via dispatcher grep — 143 actions match revenue keywords.
methodology.step_5: Verdict per page: BLOCKED only if (a) primary engine unwired AND (b) no acceptable wired substitute, OR (c) action name not found in any dispatcher case statement.
methodology.step_6: Pareto: rank hoist-units by 'pages unblocked / engines wired' ratio.

page_dep_tree.page_group: Speed/Feed Calculator (6 pages: param-editor / chip-thin / MRR / power-budget / tool-life / cost-curve)

hoist_wiring.rationale: 8 SFC-family engines in unwired pool. Core kienzle/cutting_force ALREADY wired in calcDispatcher (51 case statements), so 6 pages can ship with existing actions, but 'machine-aware' page needs MachineAwareSpeedFeedEngine wired. Hoist this single batch.

page_dep_tree.cost_estimate: 8 engines × ~40 LOC wiring + 8 engine-named .test.ts × ~120 LOC = ~1280 LOC, 1 PR

page_dep_tree.page_group: Mill (5 pages: param-editor / SLD viewer / chatter map / thermal preview / wear timeline)

hoist_wiring.rationale: SLD/Chatter Stability Lobe is the central physics for the 'SLD viewer' + 'chatter map' pages — both blocked without it. ArchardAdhesiveWear powers 'wear timeline'. vibrationPhysicsDispatcher exists but lacks SLD action.
'thermal preview' page has no extant ThermalFieldEngine in unwired pool — must be built greenfield. ~500 LOC.

page_dep_tree.cost_estimate: 4 hoist wirings × ~40 LOC + 4 tests × ~120 LOC = ~640 LOC + 500 LOC greenfield Thermal = ~1140 LOC, 2 PRs
page_dep_tree.ms3_origin_unit: U-WIRE-OTHER-01..03 + U-WIRE-MILL (not currently in MS3 spec — must add)

page_dep_tree.page_group: Lathe (7 pages: turning-param / threading / hard-turn / chip-control / cost-opt / quality-gate / mill-turn-sync)

hoist_wiring.rationale: MillTurnCAMEngine is THE engine for U-REV-LATHE-07 (mill-turn-sync page) — page is hard-blocked without it. LathePartClassifier + SequenceOptimizer + MultiOpPlanner power the turning-param editor's intelligence layer.
AI-tier turning intelligence + tolerance-stack reuse from quality. Per WIRE-TO-ALL doctrine, wire to both.

page_dep_tree.cost_estimate: 10 engines × ~40 LOC × 2 dispatchers (WIRE-TO-ALL) + 10 tests × ~120 LOC = ~2000 LOC, 2 PRs
page_dep_tree.ms3_origin_unit: U-WIRE-LATHE-01..02 (89 engines in MS3 lathe batch — but currently scheduled AFTER MS0)

page_dep_tree.page_group: WEDM (5 pages: feasibility / cost / program-gen / pass-schedule / wire-controller-select)

hoist_wiring.rationale: MultiSetupFeasibilityChain powers 'pass-schedule' page; WEDMScheduling powers 'cost' page time-to-completion; ProgramIndex feeds 'program-gen' page.
Part recognition + material char power 'feasibility' page input pipeline; wire-threading powers 'wire-controller-select' page.

page_dep_tree.cost_estimate: 7 engines × ~40 LOC × 1.5 dispatchers avg + 7 tests × ~120 LOC = ~1260 LOC, 2 PRs
page_dep_tree.ms3_origin_unit: U-WIRE-WEDM (currently in REMAINING-01..07 batches — 67 WEDM engines in unwired pool)

page_dep_tree.page_group: Quality (4 pages: SPC chart / FAI editor / CMM-parse view / tolerance-stack viz)

hoist_wiring.rationale: SPCProcessCapability + MultivariateSPC are direct page dependencies; HyperMill bridges enable the 'FAI editor' integration; TurningInspectionPlan feeds 'tolerance-stack viz'.

page_dep_tree.cost_estimate: 7 engines × ~40 LOC + 7 tests × ~120 LOC = ~1120 LOC, 1 PR

page_dep_tree.page_group: Admin (7 pages: user-mgmt / seat-assign / billing-portal / API-key-gen / RBAC-role / audit-log / sub-tier-editor)

hoist_wiring.rationale: SessionLifecycle powers login/logout flow across all 7 admin pages; TenantOnboarding powers seat-assign; UserModel + AuthorityRanking power RBAC-role editor. NOTE: AuthDispatcher+TenantDispatcher exist (verified) — these engines just need wiring INTO them.

page_dep_tree.cost_estimate: 5 engines × ~40 LOC × 2 dispatchers + 5 tests × ~120 LOC = ~1000 LOC, 1 PR. Plus GREENFIELD billing engines (see below).
page_dep_tree.ms3_origin_unit: U-WIRE-OTHER (auth engines in unwired Other-142 batch)
page_dep_tree.greenfield_note: REVENUE-MS1 already declares these — but MS1 depends on MS0 ADMIN per spec line 90. This is the F-r2-a1-03 circular dep manifesting here. Resolution: MS1 billing engines must ship CONCURRENT with MS0-ADMIN, not after. Pull 4-6 billing units forward into MS0 ADMIN sub-batch.

page_dep_tree.page_group: Learn (3 pages: tutor / video-learn player / blueprint-read trainer)

hoist_wiring.rationale: PrintToProgramTutorial powers 'blueprint-read trainer'; VideoReplayOrchestrator+Pipeline power 'video-learn player'; TribalExplanation + KnowledgeIngestion power 'tutor' page.

page_dep_tree.cost_estimate: 6 engines × ~40 LOC × 2 dispatchers + 6 tests × ~120 LOC = ~1200 LOC, 1 PR
page_dep_tree.ms3_origin_unit: U-WIRE-OTHER + currently no dedicated LEARN batch

pareto_minimum_hoist.rationale: ADMIN pages gate ALL revenue (no billing → no $) AND every other MS0 page invokes session/auth middleware. F-r2-a1-03 root cause.
Highest unwired-pool density (106 lathe engines); 7 pages = 19% of MS0 surface; mill-turn-sync page literally has no alternative engine.
67 unwired WEDM engines — domain has zero MS3 priority in current spec ordering.
Self-contained quality batch, single PR; unblocks 4 pages.
Smallest hoist that unblocks 5 pages — SLD/Chatter is the keystone; 'thermal preview' needs greenfield.

remaining_blocked: U-REV-LEARN-01..03 (depends on LEARN hoist not in top-5)
pareto_summary.claim: Hoisting 33 unwired + 7 greenfield = 40 engines unblocks 28/37 = 75.7% of MS0 (Pareto floor). Adding LEARN-01 hoist (6 engines) = 34/37 = 91.9%.
pareto_summary.vs_full_ms3: Full MS3 wires 875 engines; Pareto subset is 40 engines = 4.6% of MS3 effort to unblock 75% of MS0.

greenfield_recommended.rationale: No equivalent in unwired pool; Stripe/billing-specific logic; ~600 LOC + StripeAdapterEngine
Spec-mentioned in MS1 U-SUB-04; no unwired equivalent
Spec mentions 'API key gen' page; closest unwired = SkillTierRegistry (wrong domain)
Spec MS1 U-SUB-05 names it explicitly as 'new:'
Spec MS1 U-SUB-06 names it explicitly as 'new:'
U-REV-MILL-04 'thermal preview' page — no Thermal engine in unwired pool (THERMAL keyword returned 0 hits in unwired audit)

top_3_hardest_to_unblock_pages.why: Requires THREE greenfield engines (Billing + Stripe + SubscriptionTier) AND payment-gateway credentials AND PCI compliance review. Cost: 1500+ LOC + external auth flow + Stripe webhook handler. F-r2-a1-03 manifests strongest here — MS0 needs MS1's billing, but MS1 was scheduled to wait on MS0.

No ThermalFieldEngine exists in unwired pool (verified — 0 hits for 'Thermal' keyword in 875 unwired). Requires greenfield FEM/heat-transfer engine ~500-800 LOC plus physics validation. WIRE-TO-ALL doctrine forces wire-to-calc + wire-to-mill + wire-to-safety = 3-dispatcher path.

MillTurnCAMEngine exists in unwired pool but is the SOLE engine for this page; loses if wiring drifts. Cross-cuts turning + mill domains; per WIRE-TO-ALL needs prism_turning + prism_mill + prism_5axis triple-wire (3 dispatchers, 3 round-trip tests). LATHE batch is 89 engines — currently sequenced AFTER MS0 in MS3, creating the F-r2-a1-03 circularity.

summary.verdict: F-r2-a1-03 CONFIRMED + BOUNDED: 33/37 MS0 pages depend on engines currently scheduled for MS3 wiring; circular dependency real. Pareto-minimum repair = 5 hoist sub-units wiring 33 unwired engines + 7 greenfield = 40 engines total (4.6% of MS3's 875) unblocks 75.7% of MS0. Cost estimate ~8,200 LOC across 9 PRs. MS1 billing must ship concurrent with MS0 ADMIN, not after.
summary.one_line: Hoist 5 MS3 sub-batches (33 engines) + 7 greenfield = 40 engines unblocks 28/37 MS0 pages (Pareto 76%); the remaining 4.3% MS3 effort can fully ship MS0.
